events.title: Next Fest Squad Challenge: Climb the Leaderboard, Win Early Access
events.summary: Steam Next Fest is here, and we want to see which squad can climb the highest in Rebels of the Realm.How it worksWhen you create a lobby, turn on Steam Next Fest Challenge.Everyone in the lobby plays on a separate challenge save starting from 0. Your normal save isn’t touched, and you can go back to it any time.The highest tier reached wins. If two squads reach the same tier, the fastest clear wins.PrizesThe top 3 squads each win an Early Access key for every squad member when the game launches
